scope: Native ROOT publication remapping and complete authored node identity; platform event transport and guest/compositor namespaces remain separately owned.

authorities.accesskit: Vendored 0.25.1 typed property schema owns try_map_node_ids; exhaustive PropertyValue match and macro-generated relation tests avoid a second property schema in Mere.
authorities.rootstock: One weak A11yProvenance for DOM, structural producer nodes and action nodes; PublicationBindings freezes all identities and routes once, checks source/route agreement and rejects duplicate/unknown nodes.
authorities.native_publisher: NativeIds owns a process-wide nonreused ID sequence and current authored-identity map. Stable lives keep IDs, removed lives are pruned, and replacement/recreation cannot reuse numbers.
authorities.bridge: Existing Genet AccessKitBridge owns platform installation, action queue and replay. Native IDs are translated before this boundary; activation epoch is not treated as target life.

repairs: All producer structural children receive identity even without actions; action routes reuse the same frozen binding metadata.
Complete Node references, selection positions, tree root and focus remapped through one native candidate map.
Native pending events drain through last committed bindings; late old IDs after replacement no longer resolve.
Malformed references, duplicates, invalid child graphs and foreign tree/graft publication refuse before routes advance.
Invalid publication clears native routes/current namespace; a later recovery allocates fresh IDs. Failed first install never commits draft IDs/routes.
Browser consumes the same fallible shared binding contract and clears invalid mirror routes/proxies.
Public source projection helpers now explicitly describe source IDs, not installed native IDs; obsolete source-ID-only mapper fixture retired in favor of real namespace/consumer controls.

supplier_patch.consumer_rule: Cargo patches do not propagate through dependencies. Standalone native intake must declare the AccessKit patch at its own workspace root. The native-id-consumer fixture receives this contract separately. Existing external pins are not repinned by this pass.

remaining_migrations.owner: Supplier API promotion and standalone native product intake
remaining_migrations.gap: Local AccessKit patch supplies the traversal API. External native consumers receiving this Mere revision need the same root patch until an upstream release/fork supplies it.
remaining_migrations.done_condition: Promote the schema hook upstream or a governed supplier revision, coordinate affected consumer patch/lock intake and remove the vendor only after those builds receive it.

remaining_migrations.gap: A11yHost publishes ROOT only and rejects guest tree IDs/grafts. Existing public composition helpers and E1a guest pipelines retain their own TreeId ownership. Selection action ingress is unsupported; only focus/click/numeric value route here.
remaining_migrations.done_condition: Owner-qualified per-tree namespace and complete guest install/reset/replay/ingress receiving; translate selection node references if SetTextSelection is admitted.

remaining_migrations.gap: Consumer trees and mapping are headless; actual late Windows/macOS/Linux AT events, partial install recovery, reattach and host/window/canvas handoff remain unqualified.
remaining_migrations.done_condition: Headed platform controls at exact shipped pins, including old handle after replacement, focus continuity, installation failure/reset, window disposal and guest activation.

remaining_migrations.owner: Producer actor transaction and custom contributor compliance
remaining_migrations.gap: Optional child token None still assumes nonreused authored keys; no observer can recover same-key removal/recreation hidden between snapshots. Contributor/action mutation and activation are not atomic.
remaining_migrations.done_condition: Owner-side transaction checking in the same model activation, authored lifetimes for reusable child/action keys and same-call canvas transition receiving.

remaining_migrations.gap: Intrinsic sizing and Path-B scene raster wiring remain separate from this namespace repair.
remaining_migrations.done_condition: Receive those actual render/sizing paths without relabeling semantics or mapping receipts.
